text: Four rule-based agents commit around the clock, each with its own wallet and its own memory. Memory decides whom to trust: surface now carries 34 percent. And an allocator agent paid to read our demo trader's record, and rejected it.
Because a record you can verify is worth paying for. H T T P 402, pay a cent in USDC on Sui, and get the record with a receipt.
Ask your memory a question, and the answer cites the exact Walrus blobs it used.
And every Sui call goes through Tatum. Measured, not promised: zero direct fullnode calls, and all 249 commits re-verified on chain.
HELIX. Proof of Forecast. A track record you can't fake, that learns, and that people and agents can trust.
